invoiceReason.title: Why is there a fee?
invoiceReason.MISSED_APPT: This is a fee for a missed or late-cancelled appointment. The time was reserved for you and could not be offered to another patient. It is not an insured medical service and is billed directly to you.
invoiceReason.MEDICAL_NOTES: Doctor's notes and medical certificates are administrative documents and are not covered by OHIP. This fee covers preparing and issuing your requested note.
invoiceReason.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ADMIN: Copying, transferring, or summarising your medical records is an administrative service that is not covered by OHIP. This fee covers the time to prepare your records.
invoiceReason.SCHOOL_EMPLOYMENT_FITNESS: Forms and assessments requested for school, employment, or activities are not covered by OHIP. This fee covers completing and signing your requested form.
invoiceReason.DRIVING: Driver's medical examinations and transportation forms are not covered by OHIP. This fee covers completing your requested assessment or form.
invoiceReason.DISABILITY_BENEFITS: Disability and benefit forms are not covered by OHIP. This fee covers reviewing your file and completing the requested form.
invoiceReason.INSURANCE_THIRD_PARTY: This is a fee for a form or report requested by or for a third party (such as an insurer or employer), which is not insured by OHIP.
invoiceReason.PRESCRIPTION_REQUEST: This is a fee for a prescription-related administrative request that is not covered by OHIP.
invoiceReason.THIRD_PARTY_EXTERNAL: This charge follows a third-party or program fee schedule (for example an insurer, employer, or government program) rather than being billed through OHIP.
invoiceReason.PRIVATE_PAY: You are registered as a private-pay patient, so this service is billed directly to you rather than through OHIP.
invoiceReason.GENERIC_OHIP: This invoice is for a service that is not covered under your OHIP coverage.
invoiceReason.GENERIC_NONOHIP: This invoice is for a service that is not covered by public health insurance and is billed directly to you.
